fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-07-04, the relative of the complainant, Yuvaraj Palanisamy, aged 22, left for a bank visit and could not be contacted afterwards; last seen near Amudham Park Railway Station Road in Thoothukudi. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-07-04 around 22:45 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Bharath Babu (9000000482), a family member of Yuvaraj Palanisamy, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000158. Chandran Krishnan (9000000031) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The family mentioned that Udhay Anand (9000000125) was last known to be in contact with the missing person.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone allegedly switched off shortly after leaving the campus area.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, railway station road, mobile number, suspect, witness, photograph, night
